messages:
aj: Heads-up — Locust customer private VPC deploy window is confirmed for Fri 02:00–04:00 UTC. I'm primary for deploy. Who can join the handoff at 01:30 to run preflight?

sasha: I can do 01:30. planning to run the smoke scripts and watch the canary. @aj pls share runbook link. :thumbsup:

monica: 01:30 works for me too. I'll be on rollback if needed — bringing the DB migration rollback script just in case.

aj: runbook here: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/locust-vpc-cutover.md — see section "preflight-checks" and "rollback-plan". short checklist below.

aj: preflight checklist (quick):
- customer VPN up and validated
- VPC peering routes in place
- infra manifests staged in `infra/locust/prod/*`
- canary node pool ready (2 nodes)

devon: quick code-review ping — I left one small nit in the infra PR (security group rule CIDR). I can merge after you confirm @monica that it matches customer.

monica: confirmed, CIDR matches the customer's approved block. merge when ready.

harper: Deploy-bot created calendar event and attached the preflight runbook. Event id: `evt_8f7a2` — invites sent to: aj, sasha, monica, devon, customer-ops.

deploy-bot: Automated note: quiet window request accepted. Rate limit changes will be applied at T+10m post-cutover to avoid token bursts.

aj: plan for the execution:
- 01:30 preflight meeting (15m)
- 01:45 start canary rollout to canary pool (5–10m)
- 02:00 cutover traffic switch (target)
- 02:15 run smoke tests against /health, /v1/generate (3x short), embedding sanity
- 02:30 scale up to baseline and monitor for 30m

sasha: smoke test commands I'm going to run (paste):
```
# quick smoke, use customer creds
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CUSTOMER_TOKEN" https://locust.private.redwood/health
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CUSTOMER_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://locust.private.redwood/v1/generate
```

monica: Also will tail the model node logs and watch KvCache metrics. If we see >30% latency p90 regression we rollback.

devon: Rollback plan summary:
1) switch traffic back to stable model group
2) revert any infra changes via `terraform apply -target=module.locust` if required
3) run DB migration rollback only if migration partially applied (we have pre-check, unlikely)

aj: Good. Question for customer-ops: are you okay with a 10m read-only pause during the final migration window? @customer-ops (they're invited)

harper: Customer-ops replied over email: ok with 10m read-only pause, prefer earliest window — they confirmed Fri 02:00.

sasha: small ask — can we keep the canary nodes pinned to `g5-16x` flavor during the canary to avoid noisy-neighbor variance?

aj: yes pinned. added to infra PR: `node_pool.canary.instance_type = "g5-16x"`.

monica: one more check: secrets rotation scheduled at 03:00. We should disable auto-rotation for Locust namespace for this window. I'll toggle that during preflight.

devon: noted. I'll put a hold on the Secrets rotator job: `kubectl label namespace locust maintenance=paused` during preflight.

aj: final: callout for on-call SRE — @harper you're primary pager for this window, can you confirm?

harper: confirmed. I'll be by Slack and phone. :phone: If anything >sev2, escalate to eng-oncall.

aj: thanks everyone. we'll post an update after the 02:30 monitoring period. short updates only in this thread during the window.

sasha: ack. :white_check_mark:

monica: ack.

deploy-bot: Post-deploy checklist attached to event. Reminder: upload smoke results to the deployment artifact: `s3://internal-deploys/locust/2026-03-20/`

aj: copying the smoke command outputs there after run.

(End of thread)
